name: Caesar
source:
Caesar is a stone Golem Guardian made by Dark Lord [url=/c97988]Satella[/url] with her unique ability to craft golems, and he's also her favorite guardian. He's always at Satella's side and is very protective.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Caesar]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
